719-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
719-4881-6909-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-728-5011.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

589-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
589-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1379-2685-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1379-2685-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

475-1379-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-3197-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-6205-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, if Case of the Ransacked Lab is solved, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve any number of triggers from Case of the Ransacked Lab, if it was solved, drawing any number of cards.
If the remaining number of Case of the Ransacked Lab triggers is greater than the number of cards in your library, you must win the game or remove those triggers from the stack at instant speed to avoid losing the game from drawing from an empty library.

2254-5626-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 0.
2254-5626-7487.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying zero {E}, sacrificing Zealous Lorecaster, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Zealous Lorecaster's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Zealous Lorecaster from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5470-6797-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3713-4289-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

225-539-751-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Repeat.
225-539-751-7069.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

141-3505-5147.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

413-527-2178-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-527-2178-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Selvala trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Selvala trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

560-2835-4550-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-4550-5686.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Repeat.

457-1409-5231.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Construct, adding {R}.
Repeat.

799-1891-2598-5261.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Resolve the copy of Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Holding priority, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Reprieve without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Reprieve, returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat each turn.

204-776-4182.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least six creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-4182.description:
Activate six creatures you control by tapping them, adding {5}{U} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Whispers of the Muse to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

1748-5058.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield with toughness equal to 1.
1748-5058.description:
Cast Screams from Within by paying {1}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Warehouse Tabby and Screams from Within.
Resolve the Warehouse Tabby trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Screams from Within trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Rat.
Repeat from step 2.

767-3008-3048-3197.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Druids' Repository has at least one charge counter on it.
767-3008-3048-3197.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth and two charge counters on Druids' Repository.
Herd Baloth triggers twice, creating two 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Druids' Repository twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

232-2136-2178-5256.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
232-2136-2178-5256.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token.
When the Priest of Urabrask token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Priest of Urabrask token's power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

1409-4050-4749.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Somberwald Beastmaster.
1409-4050-4749.description:
Activate Somberwald Beastmaster by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Somberwald Beastmaster.
Resolve the Somberwald Beastmaster trigger, creating a 2/2 Wolf, 3/3 Beast and 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two of the tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

851-1765-2232-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have an Aura card in hand with mana value one or less.
You control an Aura with mana value one or less.
You have enough mana available to cast the Aura in hand.
851-1765-2232-4050.description:
Cast an Aura with mana value one or less by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control.
The Aura enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Chishiro.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return any other Aura with mana value one or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3088-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3088-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3088-3469-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
